user.description: Set up the Home Energy Management System. Devices and meters are declared in configuration.yaml.

data.tempo_red_prep_enabled: Tempo: pre-charge before a red day
data.tempo_red_prep_soc_pct: Tempo: target SoC before red day (%)
data.anticipatory_curtailment_enabled: Anticipatory PV curtailment (pre-brake from the forecast, before the batteries fill)

data_description.zero_injection_setpoint_w: Target grid power in watts. 0 = exactly zero injection. Negative values allow a small safety export buffer.
data_description.pv_forecast_entity: Entity ID of a sensor providing current PV forecast in watts (e.g. from Solcast or Forecast.Solar).
data_description.weather_warning_entity: Entity ID of a binary_sensor or sensor representing a Météo-France weather warning.

data.dry_run: Dry-run (compute everything, never write to hardware)
data.noncontrollable_stale_s: Non-controllable battery staleness limit (s): ignore its power past this (e.g. a lagging cloud battery); 0 disables
data.baseline_floor_margin_w: Baseline floor margin below talon (W): floor the shown baseline at max(0, talon − margin) so a stale cloud battery discharging can't drive it negative
data.fleet_reversal_dwell_s: Charge↔discharge reversal dwell (s): keep the fleet in one direction this long before reversing, so a solar-first box (STREAM) doesn't thrash self_powered↔scheduled near house=PV; 0 disables
data.anticipation_horizon_min: Anticipation horizon (min): how far ahead the sink budget is projected. Longer = brakes earlier
data.anticipation_margin_w: Anticipation margin (W): forecast export must beat the sink budget by this much before pre-curtailing (guards against forecast noise)
data.solar_fallback_safety_pct: Solar-only fallback: share (%) of the *estimated* surplus actually commanded. Below 100 so an underestimated house load eats the margin instead of drawing from the grid.
data.evening_peak_start_h: Evening peak start (local hour) covered by the reserve.
data.evening_reserve_max_pct: Largest share (%) of usable capacity the evening reserve may claim, so an expensive predicted evening cannot pin the whole pack.
data.actuator_lag_s: Actuator lag (s): how long the hardware takes to act on a new setpoint. ~30 s on an EcoFlow STREAM over BLE. Sets how much wider the balance-point resume threshold is; 0 = no widening.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of SolarBalance is allowed.

data.tempo_red_prep_enabled: Tempo: pre-charge before a red day
data.tempo_red_prep_soc_pct: Tempo: target SoC before red day (%)
data.evening_shed_min_power_w: Shedding: min power of a "big" load (W)
data.overload_protection_enabled: Active overload protection (shed loads before the breaker trips)
data.no_battery_export: Strict self-consumption: never discharge the battery into the grid (blocks injection)
data.local_ac_load_entities: Local AC-load sensors behind the fleet (e.g. STREAM AC sockets) — excluded from the grid loop so their cycling doesn't disturb it
data.pv_drop_compensation_enabled: PV-drop compensation: on a sudden PV drop (cloud), discharge the lost PV immediately (faster than the loop)
data.anticipatory_curtailment_enabled: Anticipatory PV curtailment (pre-brake from the forecast, before the batteries fill)
data.appliance_power_entities: Appliance power sensors (washing machine, dishwasher…) — their cycles are learned so the panel can advise when running one would be covered by solar. Observed only, never controlled.
data.grid_backup_entity: Backup grid sensor — used when the PDL meter goes unavailable, so a meter dropout no longer suspends regulation. Same sign convention as the PDL.
data.solar_fallback_enabled: Keep storing solar when the grid meter is unavailable — estimates the surplus from measured PV minus the learned house load and charges a derated share of it. Charge only, never discharge (without a meter an export could not be detected).
data.evening_reserve_enabled: Keep back what the evening peak will need — sizes a reserve from the learned evening consumption minus the PV forecast, holds it through the day and releases it at the peak. Only ever blocks a discharge, never forces a charge. Works on a flat tariff.
data.balance_hysteresis_enabled: Balance-point hysteresis — the deadband is a single threshold, so an error hovering at it flips the loop between regulating and idle every tick, and each flip is a real command to hardware that answers ~30 s later. This settles inside the deadband and resumes only past a wider one, scaled by the actuator lag. Widened on the import side only: export never gets extra tolerance.

user.title: Battery
user.description: Declare a battery. Setpoint fields are only needed if you enable active control.

data.name: Name
data.charge_ceiling_soc_pct: Charge gate: allow charging up to this SoC (%)
data.charge_priority_target_soc_pct: Charge priority: fill first up to this SoC (%)

data_description.power_entity: Single signed sensor. Must be POSITIVE while charging (else flip the convention). Leave empty if you use the two charge/discharge sensors below.
data_description.charge_power_entity: Alternative to the signed sensor: charge power (always >= 0). Pair with discharge.
data_description.discharge_power_entity: Alternative to the signed sensor: discharge power (always >= 0). Pair with charge.
data_description.power_sign_convention: charge_positive = positive while charging. Otherwise discharge_positive. Ignored when the two charge/discharge sensors are used.
data_description.active_control_enabled: If on, SolarBalance writes setpoints (requires a controllable battery and the setpoint entities).
data_description.charge_limit_soc_setpoint_entity: Charge-only gate (e.g. River 2): a SoC-limit number SolarBalance raises to charge / lowers to the current SoC to stop. On the River 2 use the Backup Reserve Level number (Energy Backup/EPS on). Leave the reserve field below empty.
data_description.charge_ceiling_soc_pct: SoC the gate raises the limit to when there is surplus (default = max SoC).
data_description.charge_priority_target_soc_pct: If set, this battery is charged first from surplus (before the fleet) until this SoC — for a small station you want topped up.
data_description.reserve_soc_setpoint_entity: Storm-mode min-SoC (number %), raised to the target during storms. E.g. number.ef_xxxxxx_backup_reserve. NOT the charge gate — leave empty on a charge-only River 2 (use the charge-gate field above).
data_description.ac_charge_limit_w: Max power absorbed from AC (SoC equaliser).

error.invalid_device: Invalid battery configuration: {reason} — check the entities (domain required, e.g. number.x) and setpoints.
error.battery_no_power: Missing battery power sensor: set the signed Power entity, OR both the Charge and Discharge power entities.
error.battery_active_no_setpoint: Active control is on but no setpoint entity is set — add a charge, discharge or mode setpoint (number./select.), or turn Active control off.
error.battery_active_needs_controllable: Active control requires a controllable battery — enable Controllable, or turn Active control off.

user.title: Controllable load
user.description: Declare a load (water heater, EV…). Fields depend on the control type.

data.name: Name
data.assist_floor_soc_pct: Fast charge: min battery SoC to assist (%)
data.pause_when_inefficient: Fast charge: pause rather than slow-charge

data_description.control_type: on_off (switch), stepped (levels, e.g. EV by amperage), modulating (continuous power).
data_description.steps: For stepped: comma-separated 'level:watts'. The level is written to the level entity (e.g. the amperage).
data_description.switch_entity: Actually stops charging (useful when setting amperage to 0 does not).
data_description.fast_charge: Prefer an efficient fast charge + battery assist (when recoverable) over a lossy slow charge.
data_description.deadline_before: Target time (e.g. 07:00). With the required energy, forces a grid charge if solar is insufficient.

user.title: Solar inverter (MPPT)
user.description: Declare an inverter/micro-inverter. Curtailment needs active control + a limit entity.

data_description.peak_power_w: Inverter max power; the curtailment upper bound.
data_description.power_entities: List every production sensor. For inverters with one per string and no total (e.g. Indevolt), add them all — they are summed.
data_description.power_limit_setpoint_entity: number/W the inverter obeys as its output limit (zero-injection curtailment).

user.title: Power meter
user.description: Declare a meter. The PDL (grid connection point) drives zero-injection regulation.

data_description.kind: pdl = grid connection point ; pv ; consumption ; subcircuit.
data_description.power_entity: Must be POSITIVE on import, NEGATIVE on export (e.g. Shelly 3EM).
data_description.invert_sign: Enable for meters reporting + = export / − = import (e.g. Huawei) — no template helper needed.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Suspends all HEMS decisions. The engine stops running until resumed.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Resumes normal HEMS operation after a pause or manual override.

force_charge.name: Force charge
force_charge.description: Force all batteries to charge at maximum power until the target SoC is reached.

force_discharge.name: Force discharge
force_discharge.description: Force all batteries to discharge until the floor SoC is reached.

set_mode.name: Set mode
set_mode.description: Directly set the global HEMS operating mode.

activate_storm_mode.name: Activate storm mode
activate_storm_mode.description: Manually trigger storm-preparation mode: ramp SoC to the storm target.

reset_baseline_talon.name: Reset standby baseline (talon)
reset_baseline_talon.description: Discard the learned night standby baseline and re-estimate it next quiet night. Use after a one-off big night load (e.g. EV charging) inflated it and caused wrong load shedding.
